Package the prediction models for distribution

Source: R/mlmorph_models.R
pack_mlmorph_models.Rd

For the maintainer: copies, from an ml-morph folder, exactly what prediction needs – the ONNX networks (global localisation, fine landmarks, ruler, ruler period, and the three regional refinements) with their parameter files and the canonical frame of the training set – into a zip with a manifest (MANIFEST.tsv: every file, its size and md5; VERSION). The training checkpoints and datasets are left out (a few hundred MB instead of several GB).

Usage

pack_mlmorph_models(
  mlmorph_dir,
  version,
  out_dir = ".",
  refine = TRUE,
  package_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

mlmorph_dir

The ml-morph folder holding the mlmorph_run_* models.

version

Version of the bundle ("1", "2", ...).

out_dir

Where the zip is written.

refine

Include the three regional refinement networks (used by default by the prediction when present; ~140 MB).

package_dir

Optional: the source folder of intraitR, whose R/mlmorph_models.R gets the version, file name and checksum.

Value

Invisibly, the path of the zip.

Details

Publish the zip as an asset of a GitHub release of intraitR tagged models-v<version>. With package_dir, the source of intraitR is updated so that this version of the package installs this version of the models (install_mlmorph_models()); otherwise the lines to paste are printed.

See also

install_mlmorph_models()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pack_mlmorph_models("~/ml_morph", version = "1", out_dir = "~/Desktop",
                    package_dir = "~/Packages/intraitR")
} # }
